subject: Re: MAP: Vendor onboarding & procurement next steps (Ariba/Coupa, W-9, banking)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Thompson <laura.thompson@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP draft: Vendor onboarding & procurement steps

Hi Laura —

Thanks again for taking the call this morning. Per our discussion, I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the vendor onboarding / procurement milestones so we have clear owners and dates. High-level summary below: 

Milestones & target dates:
- Ariba/Coupa supplier registration: target 2026-06-10 (Owner: Acme Procurement)
- Vendor form & onboarding questionnaire completed: target 2026-06-08 (Owner: Acme Procurement)
- Redwood provides W-9 + banking instructions: 2026-06-04 (Owner: Redwood)
- Internal security & legal review (Acme): 2026-06-11 (Owner: Acme Legal)
- PO issuance / payment terms agreed: target 2026-06-15 (Owner: Acme Procurement / Redwood Finance)

Dependencies & notes:
- Ariba/Coupa invitation or supplier ID from Acme speeds onboarding (we can also self-register if you prefer).
- If your legal team requires a specific onboarding packet, let us know and we will prioritize customizing the materials.
- Payment terms: Redwood standard is Net-30; if you require Net-60 we can escalate to finance for approval (please confirm).

Requested next steps:
1) Confirm the Acme procurement contact who will own the Ariba/Coupa registration (I can copy them into the MAP).
2) Review the attached MAP-draft and onboarding guide — I added responsibilities and deadlines.
3) If that looks good I’ll send the final MAP and attach our W-9 + banking instructions.

Attachments: MAP-draft-Acme.xlsx, Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Guide.pdf

If helpful, we can schedule a 20-minute call with your procurement lead this week to walk through Ariba steps.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Laura Thompson <laura.thompson@acme-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-03T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft: Vendor onboarding & procurement steps

Marissa —

Thanks for the thorough recap and the MAP draft. This looks good. Please add our procurement lead: Steven Park (steven.park@acme-analytics.com) as the owner for the Ariba/Coupa registration and vendor forms.

A couple of questions from procurement:
- Do you have an Ariba supplier ID or can Redwood send an Ariba invite? Our preference is supplier invites through Ariba.
- We generally require W-9 and vendor banking instructions before PO issuance — can you attach those?
- Can you accept Net-60 on invoices? We have a standard Net-60 for new suppliers, but can be flexible if needed.

If you can provide the W-9 and a short vendor packet plus an Ariba invite, Steven will own the rest of the flow.

Thanks,

Laura Thompson
VP, Procurement | Acme Analytics
laura.thompson@acme-analytics.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Thompson <laura.thompson@acme-analytics.com>, Steven Park <steven.park@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-03T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft: Vendor onboarding & procurement steps

Laura / Steven —

Great — thanks for the quick reply. I’ve attached our W-9 and banking instructions (Redwood_W9.pdf, Banking_Instructions.pdf). I can either:

1) Create and send an Ariba supplier invite to Steven (we have a small vendor onboarding team that can initiate on our side), or
2) Provide the Ariba/coupa registration details and our supplier profile so you can add us directly.

Please confirm which you prefer and I’ll action immediately.

Regarding payment terms: Redwood’s standard is Net-30. I’ve looped in our finance lead, Rafael Mendes (cc’d), to evaluate Net-60 for this account. Rafael — if we treat Acme as a strategic partner for this PoC and given expected initial volume, can finance approve Net-60 for the first 90 days pending normal credit checks? If not, what would be the approval path and typical timing?

Updated MAP notes (I updated the spreadsheet and highlighted the items below):
- Redwood deliverables by 2026-06-04: W-9 + banking instructions (attached), onboarding guide (attached).
- Acme deliverables by 2026-06-08: Completed vendor form & onboarding questionnaire.
- Target close for onboarding / PO: 2026-06-15 — holding this as the MAP close date unless procurement needs to adjust.

HubSpot deal reference: https://hubspot.com/deals/12345
Ariba invite reference (if you want us to send): https://app.ariba.com/invite/REDWOOD-ACME
SOW / signature link (if needed later): https://app.docusign.com/some-sow-link

I’ll wait for confirmation on Ariba invite vs. self-registration and Rafael’s guidance on terms.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Fwd: MAP draft: Vendor onboarding & procurement steps — Acme (Net-60 request)

Rafael / Camila —

Forwarding the thread with Acme (Laura + Steven). They prefer an Ariba invite and have requested Net-60 on invoices for onboarding. Can you please advise on the following?

1) Rafael — can finance approve Net-60 for an initial 90-day period for Acme (deal RDW-2026-ACME-1)? If not, what approvals are required and estimated timing?

2) Camila — if finance signs off, are you able to have vendor onboarding team send the Ariba supplier invite to steven.park@acme-analytics.com? I can provide any additional fields they need.

Quick ask: if both of you confirm today I’ll send the Ariba invite and finalize the MAP with target close 2026-06-15.

Thanks —

Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
